name: tally-excel
description: Tally: a private AI agent for Microsoft Excel on Mac, running on a local Ollama model.

scripts.sideload: mkdir -p ~/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Excel/Data/Documents/wef && rm -f ~/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Excel/Data/Documents/wef/ollama-agent.xml && cp manifest.xml ~/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Excel/Data/Documents/wef/tally.xml && echo 'Tally is registered. Restart Excel, then Home > Tally (or Insert > Add-ins > My Add-ins > Developer Add-ins).'
scripts.bench:selftest: node scripts/lib/mock-fidelity.mjs && node scripts/bench/oracle.mjs && node scripts/test-agent-loop.mjs && node scripts/test-fill-down.mjs && node scripts/test-describe.mjs && node scripts/test-compare.mjs && node scripts/test-write.mjs
